verdict: A near-faithful rebuild where every block, text and photo sits where it should, held back by systematic sub-pixel text drift, icons drawn pure black instead of Wikipedia's grey and a few off greys, built as reasonably named flex HTML but with copy-pasted heading/link styles and absolutely placed top-level blocks.

top_defects.where: column bodies, section headings and Appearance panel
top_defects.what: text baselines drift 0.5-1 CSS px (1-2 device px) up throughout (e.g. 'From today's featured article', body lines, 'Text'/'Color' labels), outlining every glyph in the heatmap; Kimi Antonelli photo and caption ~1-2 px lower, 'hide' chip ~2 px right

line heights changed to fit (h1 32 px instead of 35.64, subtitle 22 px instead of 24.7) and compensated with margins, so lines land close but not exact; Appearance labels render slightly lighter than the reference

top_defects.where: header hamburger, bookmark and More icons
top_defects.what: icons rendered pure black instead of the reference's #202122 (visibly lighter/greyer), search magnifier darker via opacity 0.6 hack; bookmark-dot halo slightly smaller

top_defects.where: page tabs underline and search field
top_defects.what: tab bar bottom border #a2a9b1 noticeably darker than the reference's light grey; search field border #a2a9b1 instead of #72777d; left column border #c6e9d4 instead of #cef2e0

top_defects.where: section headings, links, Appearance radio groups
top_defects.what: four h2 headings and ~60 link spans repeat the same arbitrary classes (bg-[#cef2e0] border-[#a3bfb1]…, text-[#36c]) with no shared style; three separate templates duplicate identical radio markup; 261 arbitrary values

top_defects.where: header, page tabs, main, Appearance aside
top_defects.what: top-level blocks and the header's menu, logo, search and user links are absolutely positioned; columns have a fixed h-[640px] overflow-hidden
22 of 144 layers named; paragraphs, figures and row groups are anonymous

strengths: Every text of the reference is present and exact, including wraps ("non-/deductive", "Korwin-"), accents (Święczkowski, Sochański) and counts
Box geometry matches the measured sources: banner 44,139 1131x117, columns 519/607 wide with the right green/blue fills and heading borders
Real text throughout, provided wordmark/icons/photos used as assets, and templates for user links and radio options
